messages:
maria: incident-bot just paged billing: large token-count delta and automatic overage flags started 09:12 UTC. ~5% of accounts flagged. anyone oncall for billing?
incident-bot: Paging oncall-billing (severity: high) — token_count_spike detected in /metering/emit pipeline. Link: https://internal/alerts/1758004321
oncall-billing: I'm on it. pulling emit and aggregator logs now. first glance: emitter-v2 had a rolling deploy at 09:10 and 09:12 there were 2 restarts.
josh: I saw the deploy. Deployment job log shows emitter-v2 introduced a duplicate-replay patch. It was intended to fix replays but may double-count in some in-flight batches.
lee: copying quick query to check duplication window: ```SELECT emitter_id, count(*) as tokens, count(DISTINCT request_id) as unique_reqs FROM token_emits WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY emitter_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20;```
carla: ran that on staging mirror — emitter-3 shows tokens >> unique_reqs by ~2x for a short window. running on prod now.
ops-ken: prod run results: emitter-3 tokens=1_200_345, unique_reqs=611_212 -> ~1.97x. emitter-2 looks normal.
oncall-billing: ok that maps to the accounts seeing overage flags. Need quick mitigation: can we rollback emitter-v2 or flip traffic to emitter-2 fallback?
josh: we can flip the routing rule for emitters in prod to prefer emitter-2 (stable) and drain emitter-3. Traffic switch can be done in ~2m. Rolling rollback would require a new deploy change.
lee: mitigation steps: 1) route new traffic to emitter-2 2) disable dedupe-replay patch feature flag 3) kick off targeted reconcile job to re-evaluate flagged accounts. I'll prepare the routing change.
carla: ETA on routing change?
lee: applying rule now: ```curl -XPOST https://internal/routing/switch -d '{"prefer":"emitter-2","drain":true}'```
lee: switched. Confirming connections dropping to emitter-3... connections_count emitter-3 -> 12 then 3 then 0.
oncall-billing: nice. Are we still seeing new overage flags?
carla: new flag stream dropped to baseline within 90s. No new overage flags after switch.
ops-ken: starting reconcile/cleanup run: script `scripts/reconcile_token_counts --window 15m --target accounts_flagged.csv` to compute true tokens and mark false positives. Kicking off as background job.
maria: good. customer impact: which customers were flagged? any big ones? need comms.
carla: top impacted customers: acct-A, acct-B, acct-C. All show inflated token counts in the 09:10-09:18 window. Preliminary: chargeable delta ~2x for that window; total daily impact small but visible.
oncall-billing: decision: pause billing for affected windows and disable overage notifications until reconcile completes. We will not charge for the spurious tokens. ops-ken can we generate credits preemptively?
ops-ken: yes. once reconcile finishes we can compute delta and auto-issue credits via billing-run with tag `incident-1758004321`. I'll coordinate with finance for approval.
josh: root cause summary: emitter-v2 feature flagged replay-dedupe fix incorrectly toggled internal dedupe path -> double-count for retried in-flight batches during restart. Reproducer is in unit test added yesterday but missed integration path.
maria: next actions: - postmortem owner: josh - hotfix patch and feature-flag revert PR by EOD - reconcile job results + credits computed + external comms draft by carla - follow-up on deploy gating tests (lee)
carla: drafting customer message: "We detected an over-reporting event between 09:10-09:18 UTC due to an internal metering emitter bug. We've paused billing for affected windows, issued credits, and fixed the emitter. No action required from you." Will share once reconcile numbers are final.
incident-bot: Incident 1758004321 status -> mitigation applied (traffic switched), billing paused for affected windows, reconcile job running.
oncall-billing: handing off to josh for post-incident follow-up. I'm staying available if reconcile uncovers more.
josh: thanks. creating a tracking ticket: https://internal/tickets/IN-1758004321 and adding follow-ups: QA integ test, deploy gate, observability alert tuning.
maria: good work team. keep this thread updated with reconcile results and credits issued. :white_check_mark:
